Graduate Trainee – Supply Chain and Logistics
Nordhavn Shipping Group, Bergen

Nordhavn Shipping Group moves goods for customers across Northern Europe. Our 18-month graduate programme gives you three rotations in warehousing, transport planning and procurement, with a personal mentor throughout.

What you will do:
- Analyse stock levels and suggest improvements to warehouse flows
- Plan transport routes together with our planning team
- Take part in supplier meetings and procurement projects

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, economics or a related field
- Experience with SAP
- Fluent English, written and spoken

The programme starts in August 2027. Apply by 1 February 2027.
